```{pyodide}
import pandas as pd
limonada = pd.read_csv("dados/limonada.csv")
print(limonada.shape)
limonada.head()
```

```{pyodide}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
limonada.plot.scatter(x="temperatura", y="vendas")
plt.show()
```

```{pyodide}
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
m = smf.ols("vendas ~ temperatura", data=limonada).fit()
print(m.params)
```
